description: This file contains functions related to displaying and managing case updates in SuiteCRM, including rendering update streams, handling AJAX updates, and displaying attachments.

methods.name: display_updates
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying the stream of case updates, including toggle and expand/collapse functionality.

methods.name: display_update_form
methods.description: Returns HTML for the form to create a new case update.

methods.name: getUpdateDisplayHead
methods.description: Builds the header HTML for a single update, including contact info and attachments.

methods.name: display_single_update
methods.description: Returns HTML for a single update, formatted based on user and internal status.

methods.name: display_case_attachments
methods.description: Returns HTML links for attachments linked to a case.

methods.name: quick_edit_case_updates
methods.description: Provides the quick edit form and JavaScript for AJAX updates in the case update stream.
